Europe Topographic Map STL – 3D Model for 3D Printing & CNC

Europe Topographic Map STL is a high-resolution 3D relief model of the European continent, designed for 3D printing (FDM, SLA) and CNC milling. This model accurately represents Europe’s terrain and elevation, making it suitable for professional, educational, and creative applications.

The model is built using the Equidistant Conic projection, which preserves distances and geographic proportions across the continent. This projection is widely used in cartography and ensures reliable results for topographic visualization and physical map production.

Thanks to the closed base and clean mesh, the model is ideal for producing a CNC relief map of Europe or large-format wall maps.
